name: The Hollow 02 · Acid, bounce & darker hooks
status: Published to Spotify with exact order verified and imported into protected hosted Playlist Lab. All 50 candidates unrated at import; not a host-approved party sequence.
selection_method: 50 fresh recordings, interleaved for review. Twelve Acid, eleven Techno, ten Trance, nine Tech house and eight Drum & bass. Twenty-five returning Keep leads with new compositions and twenty-five new bedroom leads; one selection per lead, max two credited appearances. No album blocks, mixed-set excerpts or standalone intro/interlude/outro titles. Genre lanes and sonic fit notes remain editorial hypotheses.
brief: High energy, bouncy, melodic and dark underground rave music with variation. Favor contemporary acid/rave and modern trance over more classic-trance anthems; retain hard techno and selected vocal house/DnB because actual Keeps support them.

feedback_basis.interpretation: Classic-trance probes all lost while contemporary rave/trance and Astrix won; acid has a modest directional advantage. Hard techno and some bright vocal hooks were kept, so darkness, harshness, vocals or popularity alone are not treated as rules. One batch and no reasons limit confidence.

catalog_verification.composition_check: Normalized base-title plus intersecting credited artist names, with manual review of exact versions; URI/ISRC checks additionally catch rereleases. This is not an acoustic fingerprint or a complete cover-composition database.
catalog_verification.note: Catalog playability is not an audio audition, permission to download, local-file verification or a device playback test. ReccoBeats descriptors and artist genres are separately sourced.

metrics.runtime_note: Review sample only. Arithmetic overlaps are not measured mixing. Finished approved audio must still total at least nine hours after actual edits and transitions.
